name: Input Lock X
description:
GNOME Shell extension for Linux tablet mode that temporarily disables a convertible laptop's built-in keyboard and touchpad on Wayland or X11.

Requires the companion Input Lock X root daemon, installed separately from https://github.com/isalin/input-lock-x. The extension cannot access /dev/input directly; without the daemon, the panel icon reports that it is unavailable instead of failing silently.
